name: Salmon & Sesame Smash
notes:
Mob's "Absolutely Smashing Salmon & Sesame Smash". Hot smoked salmon, avocado and edamame smashed through a sesame and ginger yoghurt dressing, piled onto toast with a hit of sriracha. Ready in 15 mins.

Ingredients (whole batch):
For the dressing:
• 10g fresh ginger
• 3 tbsp Greek yoghurt
• 2 tsp sesame oil
• 2 tbsp sesame seeds
• 1 tbsp rice vinegar
• 1 tsp sugar
For the smash:
• 240g hot smoked salmon fillets
• ½ avocado
• ½ cucumber
• 1 spring onion
• 1 tbsp pickled ginger
• 100g shelled edamame
To serve:
• 3 slices sourdough
• 3 tsp sriracha
• 3 tbsp crispy fried onions
• Salt

Method:
1. Peel and grate the ginger into a large bowl. Add the Greek yoghurt, sesame oil, sesame seeds, rice vinegar and sugar with a pinch of salt, then mix until smooth and glossy.
2. Flake the hot smoked salmon into the dressing, discarding any skin. Scoop out the avocado flesh, dice the cucumber and finely slice the spring onion. Squeeze the pickled ginger dry and finely chop. Add everything to the bowl along with the edamame, then smash together with a fork, leaving some texture. Taste and season with a little more salt if it needs it.
3. Toast the sourdough. Pile the smash onto the toast, drizzle each slice with a tsp of the sriracha and scatter over the crispy fried onions.

Nutrition is Mob's figure per serving, as served in the recipe. Also per serving: saturated fat 6g, fibre 7g, sugars 9g, sodium 2030mg.

Source: https://www.mob.co.uk/recipes/hot-smoked-salmon-smash-on-toast
